newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli output up at 5-6 pct annual rate.
newsitem.headline: Israeli output up at 5-6 pct annual rate.

text.p: Israeli industrial production grew by a preliminary five to six percent in April-May, marking a pick-up from the two percent rate of the first quarter, the Central Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.
The bureau said the number of work hours of industrial employees grew at a 2.5 percent annual pace in the two months, reversing an annualised 2.5 percent decline in the first quarter.
The number of salaried employees in industry was stable in April-May after showing a 2.5 percent annualised decline in the first quarter, the bureau said.
